name: Siren of the Jagged Shoals
desc: A monstrous avian-human hybrid with a visage that shifts from haunting beauty to a terrifying maw filled with rows of needle-sharp teeth. Her hypnotic song entrances mortal minds, drawing sailors and heroes into the crushing waves where her deadly jaw awaits.
weakness: Creatures that block their hearing entirely (e.g., using beeswax or magical deafness) are completely immune to her song. If she fails to charm a target, her confidence shatters, giving attackers advantage on offense.

actions.name: Enchanting Song
actions.desc: The Siren sings an irresistible, haunting melody. Make an attack roll {ATK} against the target's mental defense. On a hit, the target is charmed and forced to spend their turn moving directly toward the Siren in a trance.

actions.name: Needle Maw Bite
actions.desc: Unhinging her jaw to reveal rows of razor-sharp teeth, the Siren bites deeply into her victim. Roll {ATK} to hit. Deals heavy piercing damage, and heals the Siren for half the damage dealt if the target is charmed.

actions.name: Discordant Screech
actions.desc: When struck by a physical attack, the Siren emits a deafening shriek. Roll {DEF} to reduce incoming damage and push the attacker 10 feet away.

actions.name: Feast on the Entranced
actions.desc: The Siren immediately makes a free 'Needle Maw Bite' attack with {ATK} against any target currently charmed by her song.
